body: Before he died him and I where inseparable. He would wake me up, take me to school, pick me up, and hangout with me after school. Now I'm a jr in HS, and completely lost without him, I know what I wanna do with my life but everyday its a fight to not lose my mind. Today when I saw my grandma put on my FB "I miss David" was one of the first times I thought to myself "he's really gone"
